chapter: Harlem, Redman's band and the Savoy
title: What the Rhythm Club was and where it stood
summary: It was a place for Black musicians to eat, drink, play cards and pool, on 132nd Street in the same building as the Lafayette Theater.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
